basic_info.description: Perched high above the city, Park Hill represents San Francisco living at its very best. Constructed in 1926 by Blakewell & Brown, this Spanish Revival Landmark was converted to condominiums in 1987. Unit 606W, one of the largest 1BR units in the complex, is notable for its 10+ft ceilings and spacious floor plan with striking walk-out balcony with planters and seating. Building amenities include a full-time front desk attendant, extra storage facilities and an entertainment area in the restored Chapel. There is a common roof deck for the building on the 7th floor. 1 car deeded covered parking space #103, HOA dues $757.23 a month. Park Hill is considered by many to be one of San Francisco's best addresses surrounded by 3.5 gated acres. Great VIEWS of City,Bay,East Bay & Hills.
